summary.text: Jack Huff is the Republican candidate for Oregon State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent James Manning (D).
He served in the U.S. Air National Guard from 1983 to 1989, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Huff earned a high school diploma from Frankfurt American High School, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as public servant.
He served in the U.S. Air National Guard from 1983 to 1989.
In his Ballotpedia survey response, Huff said he was a union representative in the 1990s.
Huff advanced from the May 19, 2026 Republican primary with 93.3% of the vote.
In his Ballotpedia survey he named election integrity as his top concern, followed by reducing taxes on individuals and businesses, and then education.
